transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I’ve gotten really scared of seeing rats. I do cleaning work, and it’s gotten bad enough that I can’t do some parts of my job anymore, like going into old building areas or trash rooms. I know in my head it’s probably not actually dangerous, but just the thought of seeing one makes me avoid it.
Is your fear of rats limited to places like work, or does it also happen in other places like your home or outside areas?

It’s mostly tied to places where I think I might see one, like at work in old parts of buildings or trash rooms. Just the thought of a rat being there can make me not want to go in, even though I know it probably isn’t really dangerous.

When you're in a place where you think you might see a rat or actually see one, do you experience strong physical reactions like a racing heart, sweating, shaking, or feeling like you need to escape right away?

Yes. If I hear scratching near a wall or see something move by a pipe, my body reacts right away. My heart starts pounding, my hands shake, and I just feel like I have to get out of there before I can even think straight.
How long have you felt this way about rats? Has this fear been present for at least six months?

Yes, it’s been more than six months. I’d say about two years now. It started after I moved into an older apartment building where people were always talking about rats, and since then it’s just kind of stuck with me.
Has this fear of rats caused you to avoid certain places or activities outside of work as well, or has it mainly affected your job? And how much has it bothered you overall in your daily life?

It’s mainly affected my job, but that’s a big part of my day-to-day life. I’ve had to refuse or put off cleaning certain buildings when I think there might be rats, and my supervisor has started asking if they can really count on me for regular routes. That worries me a lot, because I don’t want to lose better shifts or miss out on maybe getting a lead position. So overall, yeah, it’s been bothering me quite a bit.
Do you feel anxious or avoid places other than those where you might encounter rats, such as crowded spaces, open areas, or situations where you worry about being judged?
Not really, no. I don’t usually avoid crowds or open places, and I’m not especially worried about people judging me. It’s really when I think rats might be around that I get anxious or want to leave.
